description:
DEMOLITION OF FRONT ENTRANCE AND ERECTION OF
REPLACEMENT ENTRANCE STRUCTURE, EXTERNAL ALTERATIONS INCLUDING CHANGES TO
FACING MATERIALS, FENETRATION AND DOORS, PROVISION OF DRIVE-THRU LANE AND ANCILLARY DRIVE-THRU USE,
ALTERATIONS TO FRONT LAYOUT AND PARKING (AMENDED)
decision_conditions: <div style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;; line-height: 20px;"><p>Archaeology - All groundworks associated with the development, including excavation, service installation, drainage works, resurfacing and any other below-ground interventions, shall be undertaken under the supervision of a suitably qualified archaeologist. Any archaeological remains encountered during the course of the works shall be appropriately recorded and any necessary mitigation measures implemented.</p><p>Reason: To ensure that no significant archaeological remains associated with the Scheduled Ancient Monument are harmed during the carrying out of the development and to safeguard the significance of the heritage asset in accordance with Chapter 16 of the NPPF, London Plan Policy HC1 and Merton Local Plan Policy D12.</p></div>

<p class="xxmsonormal"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">No
use of the drive thru element of the development hereby permitted shall
commence until a detailed Noise Management Plan (NMP) has been submitted to and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The NMP shall set out the
measures to control and mitigate noise arising from the operation of the drive
thru and shall include, but not be limited to:</span></p><ul style="margin-top:0cm" type="disc">
 <li class="xxmsonormal"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
     &quot;Times New Roman&quot;">Management procedures including staff training,
     supervision, and protocols for managing noisy behaviour.</span><o:p></o:p></li>
 <li class="xxmsonormal"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
     &quot;Times New Roman&quot;">Monitoring and review detailing how noise levels will
     be monitored, recorded and reviewed.</span><o:p></o:p></li>
 <li class="xxmsonormal"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
     &quot;Times New Roman&quot;">Complaints procedure including response times and
     reporting to the Local Planning Authority.</span><o:p></o:p></li>
</ul><p class="xxmsonormal"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">The
approved Noise Management Plan shall be implemented in full for the lifetime of
the development unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning
Authority.</span><o:p></o:p></p><p class="xxmsonormal"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;</span><o:p></o:p></p><p>







</p><p class="xxmsonormal"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Reason:
To protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers in accordance with Policy
D12.3 of the Merton Local Plan, Policy D14 of the London Plan and the aims of
the NPPF.</span><o:p></o:p></p>

External Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason:  To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D4 and D8 of the London Plan 2021, policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.

Refuse stored - No refuse or waste material of any description shall be left or stored anywhere on the site other than within a building or refuse enclosure.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the property and the amenities of the area and to accord with Policies D3 and D6 of the London Plan 2021and policy D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.

<div style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;; line-height: 20px;"><p>The disabled parking space, cycle parking spaces and electric vehicle charging spaces shown on the approved plans shall be provided prior to the first use of the development and retained thereafter.</p><p>Reason: To ensure the provision of appropriate disabled parking, cycle parking and electric vehicle charging facilities in accordance with London Plan Policies T5 and T6 and Merton Local Plan Policies T16.3 and T16.4.</p></div>

<div style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;; line-height: 20px;"><p>Ancillary Drive-Thru Use-The drive-thru works and use hereby approved shall remain ancillary and subordinate to the primary restaurant use of the site at all times and shall not operate as a separate or independent use.</p><p>Reason: To ensure that the drive-thru remains ancillary to the principal restaurant use and to prevent the establishment of a separate use which may give rise to materially different impacts and require further assessment by the Local Planning Authority, in accordance with Chapter 7 of the NPPF, London Plan Policy SD6 and Merton Local Plan Policy TC13.8.</p></div>

Construction Vehicles - The development shall not commence until details of the provision to accommodate all site workers', visitors' and construction vehicles and loading /unloading arrangements during the construction process have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved details must be implemented and complied with for the duration of the construction process.

Reason: To ensure the safety of pedestrians and vehicles and the amenities of the surrounding area and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies T4 and T7 of the London Plan 2021 and policies T16.3 and T16.4 of the Local Plan 2024.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;
margin-left:36.0pt;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none">Tree Protection: The details and measures for the protection of the
existing trees as specified in the hereby approved document ‘Arboricultural
Survey, Impact Assessment &amp; Method Statement (BS5837:2012)' reference
'AIA/MP/0184/25' and dated ’November 2025' shall be fully complied with. The
methods for the protection of the existing trees shall fully accord with all of
the measures specified in the report and shall be installed prior to the
commencement of any site works and shall remain in place until the conclusion
of all site works. </p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;
margin-left:36.0pt;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none">Reason: To protect and safeguard the existing trees in
accordance with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy G7
of the London Plan 2021,policies 015.1, 015.2 and 015.4 of the Local Plan 2024.&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">The development shall be carried out in full accordance with
the recommendations, mitigation measures and ecological enhancements contained
within the Ecological Appraisal prepared by Ostara Ecological Services,
including the protection of retained habitats during construction, measures to
minimise light spill onto retained vegetation and the provision of biodiversity
enhancements such as bird boxes and invertebrate boxes, unless otherwise agreed
in writing by the Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal">Reason: To protect and enhance biodiversity and
ecological interests in accordance with Chapter 15 of the NPPF, London Plan
Policy G6 and the objectives of the Environment Act 2021.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">The development shall be carried out in full accordance with
the Drainage Strategy Technical Note (Ref. M45200-JNP-XX-XX-RP-C-1002 dated 12
December 2025) and drawings M45200 JNP 90 XX DR C 2001 P01, M45200 JNP 92 XX DR
C 2001 P01, M45200 JNP 92 XX DR C 2005 P01, unless otherwise agreed in writing
by the Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal">Reason: To ensure satisfactory drainage of the site and to
prevent increased flood risk in accordance with Chapter 14 of the NPPF, London
Plan Policies SI.12 and SI.13, and Merton Local Plan Policies F15.8 and F15.9.<o:p></o:p></p>

EN-US;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA">Site Supervision (Trees) - The details of the
approved document 'Arboricultural Survey, Impact Assessment &amp; Method
Statement (BS5837:2012)' shall include the retention of an arboricultural
expert to monitor and report to the Local Planning Authority not less than
monthly the status of all tree works and tree protection measures throughout
the course of the demolition and site works. A final Certificate of Completion
shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority at
the conclusion of all site works and prior to the first occupation of the
development hereby approved. The works shall be carried out in accordance with
the approved Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan. </span></p><p><span style="font-size:11.0pt;line-height:106%;

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;
margin-left:36.0pt;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none">Prior to the commencement of development, including demolition, a
detailed Demolition and Construction Environmental Management Plan (DCEMP)
shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
The DCEMP shall include:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;
margin-left:36.0pt;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none">a) An Air quality management plan that identifies the steps and
procedures that will be implemented to minimise the creation and impact of dust
and other air emissions resulting from the site preparation, demolition, and
groundwork and construction phases of the development. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;
margin-left:36.0pt;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none">b) Construction environmental management plan that identifies the steps
and procedures that will be implemented to minimise the creation and impact of
noise, vibration, dust and other air emissions resulting from the site
preparation, demolition, and groundwork and construction phases of the
development.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;
margin-left:36.0pt;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none">The development shall not be implemented other than in accordance with
the approved scheme, unless previously agreed in writing by the Local Planning
Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;
margin-left:36.0pt;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p>









</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;
margin-left:36.0pt;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none">Reason : To manage and prevent further deterioration of existing
low-quality air across London in accordance with London Plan Policies
SI1(B)(1c), SI1(B)(2d) and NPPF 199<o:p></o:p></p>

Air Quality - All Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) of net power of 37kW and up to and including 560kW used during the course of the demolition, site preparation and construction phases shall comply with the emission standards set out in chapter 7 of the GLA's supplementary planning guidance "Control of Dust and Emissions During Construction and Demolition" dated July 2014 (SPG), or subsequent guidance.

Unless it complies with the standards set out in the SPG, no NRMM shall be on site, at any time, whether in use or not, without the prior written consent of the local planning authority. The developer shall keep an up to date list of all NRMM used during the demolition, site preparation and construction phases of the development on the online register at https://nrmm.London/

Reason: To comply with Policy SI1 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy P15.10 of the Local Plan 2024.
